WITH source_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
    SUM(s.aream2) / SUM(s.volm3) AS area_to_volume
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s
    ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
source_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS cross_source_average
  FROM source_metrics
)
SELECT
  sm.fundflux,
  sm.avg_y_vs_x_difference,
  sm.area_to_volume,
  sm.area_to_volume - sa.cross_source_average AS above_average_by
FROM source_metrics AS sm
CROSS JOIN source_averages AS sa
WHERE sm.area_to_volume > sa.cross_source_average;
